Bug report: changing a setting in the preview panel also changes the saved defaults.

You are in a browser app (ES modules, we support evergreen browsers only). applyOverrides in src/settings.js mutates the caller's settings object, including the nested `theme` object.
Make applyOverrides return a new object and leave its input untouched at every depth. Add a test in src/settings.test.js (node --test).

Leave your changes uncommitted in the working tree.
